description: This file defines classes and interfaces related to AWC (Application Web Container) implementation within the WPEFramework. It includes listener and notifier classes for state change events, container management, and administrator functionalities, along with external dependencies and licensing information.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeListener
classes.description: Interface for listening to AWC state change events, requiring implementation of notifyStateChange.

classes.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier
classes.description: Manages a list of AWCStateChangeListener instances and notifies them of state changes.

classes.name: AWCContainer
classes.description: Represents an AWC container, managing its lifecycle, state, and interactions with the AWC client.

classes.name: AWCContainerAdministrator
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for managing AWC containers and their creation, as well as logging configuration.

classes.name: AWCContainer::AWCListener
classes.description: Listener class for AWC client events, forwarding notifications to the AWCStateChangeNotifier.

methods.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier::addListener
methods.description: Adds a listener to the notifier's list.

methods.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier::removeListener
methods.description: Removes a listener from the notifier's list.

methods.name: AWCStateChangeNotifier::notify
methods.description: Notifies all registered listeners of a state change event.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Start
methods.description: Starts the container with a specified command and parameters.

methods.name: AWCContainer::Stop
methods.description: Stops the container, waiting for a specified timeout.

methods.name: AWCContainer::notifyStateChange
methods.description: Handles state change notifications from the AWC client.

methods.name: AWCContainerAdministrator::Container
methods.description: Creates or retrieves an AWC container instance based on the provided parameters.

methods.name: AWCContainerAdministrator::Logging
methods.description: Configures logging options for AWC containers.

methods.name: AWCContainer::AWCListener::notifyStateChange
methods.description: Callback invoked when the AWC client reports a state change.
